changed: selectConversation marks ConversationItem.firstReply on the first reply of a thread (one run in the per-run view; Task 4e.3 widens it to a conversation). Messages.tsx shows the visible reply label only on that reply; later replies carry the same conversation.reply text in an ea-visually-hidden span referenced by aria-describedby, so the not-verified fact (ADR 0022) stays available without a visible badge. Tests: selectors.test.ts 'marks only the first reply of a thread'; composer.spec.ts 'reply label shows once after hi, hi' and 'a later reply keeps a quiet not-verified hint'. Commit fb80f63. Review harness/state/4/reviews/4b.2-r1.json (accept, two Low notes).
